## Finding the clash

Scanning inter‑residue heavy‑atom contacts, nearly all close approaches in this helical structure are normal packing (≥ 3.5 Å) or hydrogen bonds (2.7–3.1 Å), giving no positive overlap. One contact, however, is grossly short:

**GLN56 NE2 (−11.699, −8.770, −1.269) ↔ ASP60 OD2 (−10.280, −7.778, −1.311)**

- Δ = (−1.419, −0.992, +0.042) → d = **1.73 Å**
- Bondi radii: N 1.55, O 1.52
- Overlap = 1.55 + 1.52 − 0.40 − 1.73 = **+0.94 Å**

These atoms are four bonds or more from any covalent connection (different residues, i/i+4 along the helix), so the pair is not excluded. Supporting atoms of the same residue pair are only marginal (NE2···CG = 2.83 Å → +0.02; CD···OD2 = 2.93 Å → −0.11), confirming the NE2···OD2 pair as the single most severe steric clash in the model; no other residue pair approaches this magnitude.

FINAL: B:Q56--B:D60
